decisions_made.decision: Early G2P Warmup in MainActivity.onCreate() & VieNeuTTSManager
decisions_made.reason: Extracts dictionary and warms JNI SeaG2P asynchronously so first chunk phonemization takes < 5ms.

decisions_made.decision: Explicit intermediate CacheTensor recycling in acousticFrame()
decisions_made.reason: Prevents accumulation of thousands of un-recycled intermediate buffers across 16 acoustic channels per sentence.

decisions_made.decision: System memory trimming with onTrimMemory callback
decisions_made.reason: Automatically frees pre-warmed chunk cache and G2P cache when system signals low/critical memory.
